name: JK to Ero Sentouin ~Kawaii Ano Ko wa Seigi no Heroine?!~
original_name: JKとエロ戦闘員 ～可愛いあの娘は正義のヒロイン?!～
source:
BOOOOOOM!

“Kyaaaaah!”

A blinding flash erupts right in front of the Cutie-a team.

“Go!”

Following the monster’s orders, we grunts rush toward the blast site.
I spot Cutie-a Pink, unconscious, and am about to call for backup when I notice her transformation fading.

“Th-this girl…!”

It’s the high school girl I see every morning on the train.
She’s always kind to the elderly and those in trouble, but merciless to perverts. I’ve been quietly watching her for a while now.
The other Cutie-a members, injured and desperate, are running for their lives.
If they’re caught, our organization will do unspeakable things to them.
Monsters and my fellow grunts are chasing the fleeing Cutie-a team, completely unaware of what’s happening here.
As for me… I…

translation:
嘘！

“啊啊啊！”

一道耀眼的闪光在可爱的面前爆发——一支队伍。

“去！”

我们听从怪物的命令，冲向爆炸地点。
我发现粉红可爱已经不省人事，正要呼叫支援时，我注意到她的变身正在消失。

“这、这丫头……！”

这是我每天早上在火车上看到的女高中生。
她对老人和困难的人总是很友善，但对色狼却毫不留情。我已经静静地观察她有一段时间了。
其他可爱成员受伤且绝望，正在逃命。
如果他们被抓住了，我们组织就会对他们做出不可告人的事情。
怪物和我的同伴们正在追赶逃跑的小可爱，他们完全不知道这里发生了什么。
至于我……我……
